name: WriteExtractedLines
description: Step 3 of ReadBankFile. Takes the reader agent's structured output (object or JSON string) and runs the deterministic checks: required fields (valueDate, non-zero amount, payerName or reference → flag שדה חסר), low legibility (flag), duplicates against existing BankLines (same valueDate, amount, payerName, reference → flagged and not written), and the file's own summary (extractedLineCount/extractedTotal vs linesInFile/totalInFile → totalsCheck). Writes BankLines (status חדשה, checkStage ממתינה לבדיקה, lineNo, sourceRef, rawText, legibility, flags; bankLineId BL-<batch>-<n>, source priority-file), reads them back (writeVerified), updates the batch to נקרא – לאימות (or נכשל with the reason) and logs a ReceiptCheckSteps step (stage קריאה, actor סוכן הקריאה). No partial writes: lines are written only after all checks ran.

extraction.description: BankFileReader structured output (object, or its JSON string)

dryRun.description: When true, only report what would be written; nothing changes
